irregularities.title: 19-band GEMS stack index 5 (1-based band 6) was mislabelled 'te' instead of 'tc'
irregularities.evidence: Raster band descriptions of multi_layer_stack_19bands_100m.tif list band 6 as magnetic tilt/curvature ('tc'), whereas legacy BAND_NAMES[5] used 'te'.
irregularities.resolution: Patched BAND_NAMES[5] = 'tc' in src/gems78/data.py, updated STEER_BANDS[-1] = 'tc' in src/gems78/features.py, and added regression test test_band6_fixed_name in tests/test_gsc_and_emit.py.

irregularities.title: Session-1 H78-A Global holdout score (0.18257) used in-sample visible training whereas strict 4-quadrant OOF LOQO scored 0.11016
irregularities.evidence: Fitting tree models on all visible pixels in all 4 quadrants memorizes local basin physiography; evaluating H78-A strictly out-of-fold across NW/NE/SW/SE drops Seed-20 HOLDOUT-DTI from 0.18257 to 0.11016.
irregularities.resolution: All primary H78-GSC models, PU spy cleaners, and fold prevalence calibrators are evaluated strictly out-of-fold (LOQO across NW/NE/SW/SE), achieving 0.18975 (Seed 20) and 0.19762 mean across Seeds 20/30/40 — beating even H78-A's in-sample 0.18257 while eliminating spatial memorization.

irregularities.title: Unspaced top-k raster emission collapses 300 m DTI kernel efficiency via contiguous pixel runs
irregularities.evidence: In DTI (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel), adjacent dots overlap >67% of their 300 m kernels while paying full FP weight 0.2 per dot.
irregularities.resolution: Implemented exact C-accelerated 300 m submodular greedy dot emitter (src/gems78/_fast_emit.c + emit.submodular_dti_dots) tracking exact per-pixel kernel coverage M_i = max_d K(dist(i,d)) with hard min_dist=2.5 px (realised min_nn=2.8284 px, frac_nn<=1.5 = 0.0), improving strict LOQO HOLDOUT-DTI by +0.0067 over spaced greedy alone.

irregularities.title: USGS 1 m 3DEP LiDAR covers 78.9% of valid Great Basin footprint (21.1% NaN gap)
irregularities.evidence: Zero-imputing NaN LiDAR pixels creates artificial step edges along LiDAR survey boundaries and starves non-LiDAR basins of emitted dots.
irregularities.resolution: Preserved IEEE NaNs natively for LightGBM missing-value routing, fused seamless 10 m USGS 3DEP scarp crests across 100% of the footprint, and calibrated LiDAR vs non-LiDAR prevalence fold-strictly (production submission places 20.66% of dots in non-LiDAR terrain, matching true 21.1% non-LiDAR area).

irregularities.title: DrivenData competition 306 portal rejects NaN pixels or values outside [0, 1] with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'
irregularities.evidence: GeoTIFFs with nodata tags, NaN outside footprint, float rounding >1.0, or multi-TIFF archives fail DrivenData ingestion.
irregularities.resolution: Packaged via fail-closed vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py and verified automatically by scripts/verify_tif.py + pytest: single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, nodata=None, 100% finite everywhere, values strictly {0.0, 1.0}, 0 dots outside footprint, 0 dots on mapped catalogue.

irregularities.title: Evaluating frozen production GeoTIFFs directly on hide-and-recover holdout masks out hidden faults via full-catalogue 3 px collar
irregularities.evidence: Production submissions exclude flank_mask(g.catalogue, 3.0), which explicitly zeros out the 20% hidden fault segments drawn from g.catalogue.
irregularities.resolution: Evaluated all comparison rules fairly on active fold domain allow = footprint & ~flank_mask(visible, 3.0) across identical seeds (20, 30, 40).

irregularities.title: USGS SGMC fault traces partially overlap organizer-compiled geological maps
irregularities.evidence: Direct SGMC trace features inflate proxy metrics without generalising to blind Quaternary faults.
irregularities.resolution: Kept derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif 100% excluded from all features, training labels, calibration, and emission; used piedmont scarp-only C_pied purely as a zero-fit diagnostic instrument (Spearman rho=+0.5890 with live scores across 62 matched submissions).

irregularities.title: Dense blanket rasters (80k-624k positive pixels covering 39.4%-99.9% of footprint with 3 px halos) inflate asymmetric forward overlap
irregularities.evidence: Across all 1,049 unique GeoTIFFs collected from all 83 buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE* repos, dense coverage blankets (up to 624,025 positive pixels) cover up to 99.9% of valid pixels within 3 px, causing any sparse 40k fault prediction to have high one-sided forward containment while reverse containment is only 0.13-0.39.
irregularities.resolution: Reported all readings transparently in evidence/h78_gsc_uniqueness_1089.json: H78-GSC passes surface |Spearman rho|=0.45589 <= 0.90 across all 1,049 rasters, passes BOTH one-sided forward (0.68635 <= 0.70) and mutual (0.42996 <= 0.70) overlap across the entire official scored registry, passes BOTH one-sided forward (0.65448 <= 0.70) and reverse (0.64161 <= 0.70) across all 5k-75k sparse dot submissions in all 83 repos, and passes mutual 3-px overlap <= 0.56320 <= 0.70 across all 1,049 rasters.

irregularities.title: Linux buffer/page cache from reading 1,049 GeoTIFFs counts against 3.8 GiB cgroup v2 memory limit
irregularities.evidence: Sequential raster scans accumulate page cache in cgroup memory.current when swap is 0 B.
irregularities.resolution: Stored static bank in float16, pre-allocated fold structural matrices in float16, and called POSIX posix_fadvise(POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) periodically during multi-raster audits.

irregularities.title: Outbound sandbox firewall restricts direct HTTP probes to non-whitelisted USGS domains
irregularities.evidence: Sandbox network policy permits only github.com, api.github.com, codeload.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, and files.pythonhosted.org; local SHA-256 verification confirmed all 33 restored official datasets bit-identically.
irregularities.resolution: Verified all 33 official USGS/DOE/EarthScope/3DEP files via SHA-256 manifests and documented exact sandbox network status in evidence/url_reachability_audit.json and registry/sources.json.
